sentences.en: The new method has already found proponents in many countries.
sentences.zh: 新方法已经在许多国家找到了支持者。

sentences.en: Proponents of increased import duties are at odds with each other.
sentences.zh: 主张增加进口关税的人彼此意见不合。

sentences.en: Proponents of a newer study classify the golden-bellied mangabey as a distinct subspecies.
sentences.zh: 支持最新研究的人将金色腹斑疣猴归类为一个独立的亚种。

senses.zh: 支持者，拥护者,提倡者,提出认证遗嘱者
